newsitem.title: EGYPT: Interbank Egypt pound averages 3.3872/3.3903 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Interbank Egypt pound averages 3.3872/3.3903 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Cairo banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3840 to 3.3895 pounds bid and 3.3860 to 3.3925 pounds offered in the interbank market on Wednesday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3872 pounds bid and 3.3903 pounds offered. The averages compared with 3.3884 and 3.3914 on Tuesday.
Two bankers said they found it hard to find buyers for dollars. "Dollars are still flooding into the market, both for treasury bills and the stock market," said one.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) at 3.390681 buy and 3.395356 sell.
